claim: All new Aurora DB clusters created on or after February 18, 2026 are encrypted by default with an AWS owned key. Before that date, encryption at rest was opt-in: a cluster created before February 18, 2026 where you did not opt in for encryption stays unencrypted, and so do snapshots, clones and Aurora Replicas created from it. Existing clusters are unaffected.
question: Are new Aurora DB clusters encrypted by default, with which key, and what was the behavior before February 18, 2026?
